items.source: Several @Enable* annotations expose both mode and proxyTargetClass attributes. It is important to note that most of these capabilities end up sharing a single APC. For this reason, this implementation doesn't "care" exactly which annotation it finds -- as long as it exposes the right mode and proxyTargetClass attributes, the APC can be registered and configured all the same.
items.translation: 多个 `@Enable*` 注解都暴露了 `mode` 和 `proxyTargetClass` 属性。值得注意的是，这些功能中的大多数最终共享一个 APC。因此，此实现并不关心具体发现了哪个注解——只要它暴露了正确的 `mode` 和 `proxyTargetClass` 属性，就可以以相同的方式注册并配置 APC。

items.source: Registers an auto proxy creator against the current BeanDefinitionRegistry as appropriate based on an @Enable* annotation having mode and proxyTargetClass attributes set to the correct values.
items.translation: 根据当前BeanDefinitionRegistry注册自动代理创建器，前提是@Enable*注解的mode和proxyTargetClass属性已设置为正确的值。
`registerBeanDefinitions` 接口 `ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar` 中

items.source: importingClassMetadata - annotation metadata of the importing class

items.translation: registry - 当前 Bean 定义注册表

items.source:
Register, escalate, and configure the standard auto proxy creator (APC) against the
given registry.
items.translation: 注册、升级并针对给定注册表配置标准自动代理创建器（APC）。
